_README: THE AFFILIATE SLOT LAYER. One file, one edit. To monetise a provider: put the tracked link in `url` and set `affiliate` to true. The site then shows the disclosure banner and marks that row. Nothing else in the repo changes. Links stay plain and untracked until a real programme is joined.
_disclosure: Some links on this page are affiliate links. If you sign up through one, this site may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. It does not change the prices below — every price is pulled live from the provider's own public API, and the code that does it is open source.
